tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and app background under the glass. Never a surface for text on its own; content sits on glass.

tokens.name: shape-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Blurred shape behind the glass (blur 90px). Decoration only, never behind small text without glass between.

tokens.name: shape-sky
tokens.usage: Blurred shape behind the glass (blur 90px). Decoration only.

tokens.name: shape-sand
tokens.usage: Blurred shape behind the glass (blur 100px). Decoration only.

tokens.name: shape-rose
tokens.usage: Blurred shape behind the glass (blur 90px), the smallest and nearest. Decoration only.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of every glass surface: sidebar, panels, cards. Always with `backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%)`.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and fields on glass.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge around glass surfaces.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row separators inside glass. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Border of secondary buttons and fields. At least 3:1 against the glass it sits on.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, and the fill of the main button and the switch. 16:1 or more on every glass surface.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the main button.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: page leads, hints, labels. 7:1 or more on glass.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: sources under names, small notes. 6:1 or more on glass.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The only ornament: logo, dial hand, focus ring. 3:1 or more on `ground` and glass.

tokens.name: coffee
tokens.usage: Fill of the coffee button only.

tokens.name: coffee-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the coffee button.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text on `coffee`.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status text for applied updates, on `ok-bg`. Also a good-choice hint.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the applied pill.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: Status text for items that wait for a decision, on `wait-bg`. Also the quiet hours arc on the dial.

tokens.name: wait-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the waiting pill.

tokens.name: back
tokens.usage: Status text for rollbacks and failures, on `back-bg`. Also a daytime warning.

tokens.name: back-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the rolled back pill.

families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "Instrument Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: dial-time
styles.usage: The time in the centre of the week dial, in SVG units. 40px on the small dial of Overview.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The app name next to the mark in the sidebar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You see what ran and what needs your decision.

styles.name: command
styles.usage: Commands only. Never labels or data.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a button or between badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Header gaps and row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Window padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side gutter from 720px up. Below that use 16px.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Fields and list icons.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: The status panel on Overview and the schedule panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, switches and segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass surface: a light top edge, a faint lower edge and a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: The main button.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs only.

fluid.note: Only the dial and the tally numbers scale; the app is laid out once for 1280 x 720 and zooms with its window.

tokens.name: step-0
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: step-2
tokens.usage: Headings and tally numbers.
